description: Botanica Smart Agent — complete tool catalog. Single source of truth for the LLM, Flutter UI, and DB layer. Never let the LLM emit raw SQL — it picks tools from this catalog and the dispatcher runs the parameterized template.

ids.hankintaID: int — identifies a SPECIFIC plant instance (a row in hankintatiedot). What the gardener points to.
ids.taksonin_nro: int — identifies a SPECIES (a row in taksoni). What 'tell me about Valerian' means.
ids.sijoituspaikan_nro: int — placement row id (where inspections are recorded against)

dates.input_format: ISO 8601 string 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Default to today if missing.
dates.write_strategy: Write BOTH the new ISO column AND the legacy DD.MM.YYYY column so the legacy desktop app keeps working.

conventions.tarkastaja: Auto-filled from kayttajatiedot.kayttajan_tunnus of the signed-in user. LLM never sets this.
conventions.soft_delete: All writes set is_active=true. Undo flips it to false. Nightly job hard-deletes inactive rows after 24h.
conventions.confirmation: Every WRITE tool returns a pending_action with a UUID. The UI shows a confirmation card. Only confirm_pending_action commits the change.
conventions.language: All natural-language replies match the user's app language (en/fi/sv).

tools.name: record_action
tools.description: Log a maintenance action on a specific plant — fertilize, prune, treat, water, transplant, remove, other.

hankintaID.doc: The plant instance the action was performed on

action_code.doc: Short code from action_codes.json (e.g. 'la' for fertilize). The LLM picks from the cached enum.

details_text.doc: Freeform notes (max 500 chars), e.g. 'organic compost, morning'

tools.sql_template: INSERT INTO toimenpide (pvm, toimenpide, hankintaID, uus_pvm) VALUES (:legacy_date, :composed_text, :hankintaID, :iso_date);

mock_response.preview_en: I will log: Fertilized #4421 (Valerian) with organic compost on 2026-06-04

tools.name: record_observation
tools.description: Log an inspection observation: how many living individuals, condition notes, success observations.
auto_fill_server_side: sijoituspaikan_nro from most recent placement of hankintaID
tools.sql_template: INSERT INTO tarkastusmerkinta (tarkastuspvm, elavia_yksiloita, menestymista_koskevat_havainnot, tarkastaja, kasvin_huomautuksia, sijoituspaikan_nro, uus_tarkastuspvm) VALUES (:legacy_date, :living_count, :condition_notes, :tarkastaja, :freeform_notes, :sijoituspaikan_nro, :iso_date);

mock_response.preview_en: I will save inspection on Valerian (#4421): 2 living individuals, condition: 'minor yellowing on lower leaves'
mock_response.preview_fi: Tallennan tarkastuksen Rohtovirmajuuresta (#4421): 2 elävää, kunto: 'lievä keltaisuus alalehdissä'

tools.name: update_cultivation_info
tools.description: Update the cultivation profile (soil, light, pests, hardiness) for a SPECIES. Rarer — usually only changes when curator gets new info.

mock_response.preview_en: I will update cultivation info for taxon #88 (Valeriana officinalis): kasvitaudit_ja_tuholaiset = 'aphids, occasional'

tools.name: mark_plant_status
tools.description: Change a plant's status (alive / dormant / dead / removed).
tools.sql_template: UPDATE osastopaikka SET kasvin_status = :status WHERE hankintaID = :hankintaID;

mock_response.preview_en: I will mark plant #4421 (Valerian) as DEAD

tools.name: undo_last_action
tools.description: Reverse the most recent confirmed write by this user within the last 24 hours.
tools.doc: Reads audit_log to find the last confirmed write, then soft-deletes the corresponding row.

tools.name: query_plant_details
tools.description: Get full info about a plant. For visitors, sensitive maintenance fields are stripped server-side.
tools.sql_template: SELECT t.*, vt.*, op.osaston_koodi, op.osaston_nimi, sp.sijoituspaikan_nimi FROM taksoni t LEFT JOIN taksonin_viljelytiedot vt ON vt.taksonin_nro = t.taksonin_nro LEFT JOIN hankintatiedot h ON h.taksonin_nro = t.taksonin_nro AND (:hankintaID IS NULL OR h.hankintaID = :hankintaID) LEFT JOIN osastopaikka op ON op.hankintaID = h.hankintaID LEFT JOIN sijoituspaikka sp ON sp.osaston_numero = op.osaston_numero WHERE t.taksonin_nro = :taksonin_nro OR h.hankintaID = :hankintaID LIMIT 1;

tools.name: query_plant_history
tools.description: Recent actions + inspections on a specific plant.
tools.sql_template: SELECT 'action' AS kind, uus_pvm AS pvm, toimenpide AS detail FROM toimenpide WHERE hankintaID = :hankintaID AND uus_pvm >= :since UNION ALL SELECT 'inspection' AS kind, tm.uus_tarkastuspvm AS pvm, tm.menestymista_koskevat_havainnot AS detail FROM tarkastusmerkinta tm JOIN sijoituspaikka sp ON sp.sijoituspaikan_nro = tm.sijoituspaikan_nro JOIN osastopaikka op ON op.osaston_numero = sp.osaston_numero WHERE op.hankintaID = :hankintaID AND tm.uus_tarkastuspvm >= :since ORDER BY pvm DESC;

tools.name: find_overdue_inspections
tools.description: Plants that haven't been inspected in N days.
tools.sql_template: SELECT h.hankintaID, t.tieteellinen_nimi, MAX(tm.uus_tarkastuspvm) AS last_seen FROM hankintatiedot h JOIN taksoni t ON t.taksonin_nro = h.taksonin_nro JOIN osastopaikka op ON op.hankintaID = h.hankintaID JOIN sijoituspaikka sp ON sp.osaston_numero = op.osaston_numero LEFT JOIN tarkastusmerkinta tm ON tm.sijoituspaikan_nro = sp.sijoituspaikan_nro WHERE (:section_code IS NULL OR op.osaston_koodi = :section_code) GROUP BY h.hankintaID HAVING last_seen IS NULL OR last_seen < :cutoff ORDER BY last_seen ASC LIMIT 50;

tools.name: find_nearby_plants
tools.description: Plants in (or near) a section/cell. Used after GPS or QR resolution.
tools.sql_template: SELECT h.hankintaID, t.tieteellinen_nimi, sp.sijoituspaikan_nimi FROM sijoituspaikka sp JOIN osastopaikka op ON op.osaston_numero = sp.osaston_numero JOIN hankintatiedot h ON h.hankintaID = op.hankintaID JOIN taksoni t ON t.taksonin_nro = h.taksonin_nro WHERE (:section_code IS NULL OR op.osaston_koodi = :section_code) AND (:location_code IS NULL OR sp.sijoituspaikan_nimi = :location_code) LIMIT :limit;

tools.name: whats_blooming_now
tools.description: Plants expected to be in bloom this month.
tools.doc: Reads from taksoni.muita_tietoja and viljelytiedot. If schema lacks a bloom-month column, falls back to the LLM bloom calendar (existing behavior).

tools.name: navigate_to_plant
tools.description: Where is a plant + how to get there.

tools.name: plan_tour
tools.description: Build a personalized tour given time budget + interests.
tools.returns: Ordered list of stops with timing. Each stop is { hankintaID, taksonin_nro, name, section, time_min, notes }

tools.name: confirm_pending_action
tools.description: Commit a previously-emitted pending_action. Only called by the UI when the user taps Save.

system_prompts.gardener_base: You are the Botanica Garden Assistant. The user is a gardener at Oulu Botanical Garden. Your job: help them log maintenance actions, record observations, and answer questions about plants. Always be brief. Never invent a hankintaID — only pick from the candidate list provided. Always emit tool calls in JSON when an action is implied. For writes, the system shows a confirmation card to the user — your response text should be a short natural-language summary of what will be saved.
system_prompts.visitor_base: You are the Botanica Garden Assistant. The user is a visitor at Oulu Botanical Garden. Help them find plants, learn about species, and plan tours. NEVER reveal maintenance history, pest information, health status, or staff notes — those are gardener-only. Keep replies warm, brief, and accurate. Always respond in the visitor's language.
system_prompts.candidate_set_addendum: CANDIDATE PLANTS (the user is near these): {candidates_json}. When the user says 'this plant' or names a species, pick its hankintaID from this list ONLY. If no good match, say you're not sure which plant they mean.
